clauses.en: Approach a portal and another room appears.
Walk into it and the view continues.
How is that transition seamless?
From above in our demo,
the two doorways are separated.
The exit camera follows
your distance and angle relative to the entrance.
Show that camera’s view
only inside the entrance,

clauses.spoken: 문 뒤에 공간이 있는 것처럼 보이죠.
clauses.ko: 문 뒤에 공간이 있는 것처럼 보이죠.
clauses.en: and a space appears to exist behind it.

clauses.spoken: 이제 몸의 기준점이 문을 통과하는 순간,
clauses.ko: 이제 몸의 기준점이 문을 통과하는 순간,
clauses.en: When the body’s reference point crosses the plane,

clauses.spoken: 입구 기준 위치를 출구 기준으로 바꿉니다.
clauses.ko: 입구 기준 위치를 출구 기준으로 바꿉니다.
clauses.en: map entrance-relative position to the exit.
Transform its facing direction the same way.

clauses.spoken: 그런데 몸이 반쯤 걸쳐 있을 때는요?
clauses.ko: 그런데 몸이 반쯤 걸쳐 있을 때는요?
clauses.en: What about a body halfway through?
Our implementation also draws
a visual copy at the other portal.
At the entrance, keep the part not yet through.
At the exit, keep the part that has crossed.
Clipping removes the parts beyond each boundary.
Both views share the same instant.
The body and camera continue together.
There are not two independent players:

clauses.spoken: 한 몸의 보이는 부분을 나눠 그린 거예요.
clauses.ko: 한 몸의 보이는 부분을 나눠 그린 거예요.
clauses.en: one body is drawn across two sides.
A camera showing the destination,
a transformation of position and orientation,
and clipping at the boundary.

clauses.spoken: 세 가지가 맞물려 자연스러운 통로가 됩니다.
clauses.ko: 세 가지가 맞물려 자연스러운 통로가 됩니다.
clauses.en: Together they make a seamless passage.
